title: Khiladi
desc: Raj, Neelam, and Boney prank Sheetal's father with a fake kidnapping, but chaos ensues when Sheetal goes missing, putting them under suspicion and testing their innocence.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A rich businessman hides his identity and pretends to be Raju, happily doing household chores. His skills and charm help him win over his girlfriend's family, all for love.

title: Dil Aashna Hai
desc: Laila, a cabaret dancer, embarks on a heartfelt quest to find her biological mother. Despite daunting obstacles, she pushes forward, supported at every step by her devoted lover, Karan.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
desc: In a ravaged world, a brave group races to protect a woman carrying Lord Vishnu's final avatar, Kalki, from Yaskin - the ruthless god-king bent on destroying her destiny.

title: The Bengal Files
desc: Set during one of India's most turbulent eras, the story portrays people's struggle to survive with dignity, fight injustice and claim their fundamental freedom to exist.

title: Ragini MMS 2
desc: Ragini's viral video sparks buzz. A sleazy filmmaker sets his next horror movie in the same haunted house-only to stir the evil that still lurks in its shadows.

title: Apna Sapna Money Money
desc: Satyabol opposes his daughter Shivani's love for Arjun due to religious differences. Desperate to unite with her, Arjun seeks help from his cunning cousin Kishan, leading to twists.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Waqt-The Race Against Time
desc: Ishwar, facing terminal illness, decides to kick his son out to teach him responsibility. It's a tough love lesson that sparks growth and unexpected challenges.

title: Jodi No.1
desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when they both fall for his daughters.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Annapoorani : The Goddess Of Food
desc: Born into an orthodox Hindu family, Annapoorani dreams of becoming a top chef. Battling prejudice and rigid traditions, she must break barriers to pursue her passion and redefine her destiny.

title: Kahaani 2: Durga Rani Singh
desc: As Inspector Inderjeet investigates the car accident, he discovers that Vidya Sinha may not be all she appears. She has a dark past linking her to Durga Rani Singh.

title: Ghatak: Lethal
desc: Kashi witnesses the brutal rule of Katya during a visit with his father. As he dares to resist the oppression, his actions endanger the lives of his family and loved ones.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya hire Madhubala as a surrogate. But when Madhubala falls for Raj and claims the child as her own, love, betrayal, and chaos turn their lives upside down.
